A beginner-friendly 3-day full-body program designed to build foundational strength, mobility, and calisthenics technique safely.
Beginner full-body routine designed to build strength and mobility safely
This 3-day split introduces fundamental bodyweight exercises with focus on technique and form. Train 3 non-consecutive days per week (e.g. Mon / Wed / Fri) with rest days in between.
Warm up 5 minutes prior to every workout. Maintain strict form over high repetition speed. Rest 60–90 seconds between sets.
